reviews.title: The Piknik stuff.
reviews.text:
I like that you partnered with Piknik, but now we have to LOG IN when we delete the game. I needed to save space for software updates (and still do) and when I redownload an app from part of the franchise, it  told me to log in/ get a “Piknik Account”. So please please please tell Piknik to remove the logging in. And, now we try to “enjoy”stuff being aware that Piknik will pester us later to buy their subscription service so we can play. What is the point of giving us a free trial in the first place? So just ask Piknik to understand they need to stop. Or just ask them to stop collaborating with Toca Boca AB. (if it’s possible, and you want to.) Anyway, this is a conclusion, and sorry
 if I sounded pushy. I’m a kid :(

reviews.title: Remove the subscribe thingy
reviews.text: I only want to buy the makeup individually idc about the clothes or the characters. But in order to do that, I HAVE to subscribe / do a membership thing and pay monthly?  Do you know how pathetic that is? And I know I am not the only one who thinks this, go back to your original ways and only make it so you can pay individually. How money hungry can you be? You already have many apps where you beg for users to spend their  money and now this one? How sad. Instead of making us pay monthly, maybe let us pay once for what we want which used to be like what? £2? Now it’s £53 yearly? That’s so pathetic. Here’s a tip, maybe if you lower the price, maybe more people will actually play your game.

She just put like an H like 1999 and that’s not when I was born, so your kid can download the app without you knowing basically because they can type random ear of birth. So the security on this game is taking one star I would give it like three stars, but she really liked the game and played it for an hours.
And I was saying that this is the best kind of quality game that I ever had because most of the games are pretty hard for her and so that’s why I’m giving it four stars
